patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Smartlead share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Smartlead's shape. Choose Smartlead only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infra — Base from $59/mo ($39/mo yearly headline) with send/verified-e” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans lead-management; Smartlead leans prospecting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Smartlead share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; Smartlead is Cold-email outreach infra — Base from $59/mo ($39/mo yearly headline) with send/verified-email bands; higher tiers scale volume..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs Smartlead (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning lead-management vs Smartlead-leaning prospecting.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Smartlead — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; Smartlead: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Verified prospect emails are sending-plan allowances, not a full SI DB.

Poor-fit cases: Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Smartlead is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · Avoid Gong if you actually need Smartlead's motion (Cold-email outreach infra — Base from $59/mo ($39/mo yearly headline) with send/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
